The interface ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::CreateSymmetricBlockCipherCtx shall return an instance of
ara::crypto::cryp::SymmetricBlockCipherCtx implementing the algorithm
specified by the provided parameter CryptoAlgId. The interface shall return
• kUnknownIdentifier, if the provided CryptoAlgId is not supported.
• kInvalidArgument, if the provided CryptoAlgId is supported but does not refer
to symmetric block cipher en/decryption.
